question: Fill in the blank (4) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**moral**" means concerned with principles of right and wrong behavior. (नैतिक)
 
• In this context, **"education instils moral values" **emphasizes how education promotes principles of right behavior and ethics.
 
• The other options: "**arbitrary**", "**volatile**", and "**obsolete**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Education is a powerful tool for development and personal growth. It equips individuals with knowledge and skills, enabling them to seize opportunities and contribute to society. A well-rounded education not only fosters academic excellence but also encourages innovative thinking and creativity. Moreover, education instils moral__ values and ethical principles in individuals, promoting social harmony and responsible citizenship. To ensure the benefits of education are accessible to all, it is essential to eliminate barriers, such as isolation and discrimination, that hinder equal access to quality learning opportunities.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Arbitrary (मनमाना)**: means based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.
 
• **Volatile (अस्थिर)**: means liable to change rapidly and unpredictably, especially for the worse.
 
• **Obsolete (पुराना)**: means no longer produced or used; out of date.
